app.title: WCAG Accessibility Auditor
app.tagline: Check a web page's conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA, and track how it changes over time.

home.intro: Enter a public web page URL to audit it against WCAG 2.1 level AA.

scanForm.urlHint: Full address, including http:// or https://
scanForm.labelHint: A name to find this site easily later, e.g. "Marketing site"
scanForm.submitting: Scanning… this can take up to 30 seconds.
scanForm.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while scanning. Check the URL and try again.

dashboard.heading: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Sites submitted for audit and their latest result.
dashboard.empty: No site has been audited yet. Go back to the home page to run a first scan.

scanDetail.heading: Scan results
scanDetail.notFound: This scan could not be found.
scanDetail.failed: The scan failed. The URL may be unreachable or invalid.
scanDetail.noViolations: No violations found for this severity level.
scanDetail.noViolationsAtAll: No violations found. This does not guarantee full conformance (see the accessibility statement).

siteHistory.heading: Site history
siteHistory.notFound: This site could not be found.
siteHistory.noScans: No scan has been run for this site yet.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
